results.title: A NOW drawn by boys and girls worried about housing
results.description: About thirty boys and girls joined us yesterday at the ARA newsroom to finish shaping the illustrated newspaper. However, it was hundreds of students from 10 schools in the Camp de Tarragona area who helped us complete today's newspaper with their drawings. A new edition, then, of the special ARA for International Children's Day. Here you have a collection of photos from the day and the illustrations that were made yesterday by the most anticipated visitors of the year.
